# ARPG

> ARPG (a random password generator) is a secure, client-side web application
designed to generate random passwords and passphrases. It provides flexible
settings for length and character sets, and calculates password entropy to
ensure cryptographic strength.

## Scripts

- [Password generator](https://a-random-password-generator.pages.dev/scripts/password-generator.js):
The core JavaScript module handling button clicks, password generation and
entropy calculation.
- [Word list](https://a-random-password-generator.pages.dev/scripts/get-word-list.js):
A JavaScript module exporting a predefined array of three-letter words for
passphrases.
